rows.ARS:
Orange blend.
Exhibition name: Bright Future
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gordon Wilson Kirkham (United Kingdom, 2007).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 2007 as 'Bright Future'.
rows.Bloom: Orange blend or orange-red. Bright orange aging to apricot, yellow stamens. Sweet fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form.
rows.Habit:
Climbing. Medium, light green foliage.

Height: 10' (305cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Vigorous. Remove unproductive wood every third year or so.
